fact: The Force Annual Policing Plan 2021 says that in August 2020 the Crime Occurrence Tracking System was being used for an average of 30% in Divisions, raised to over 80% in December 2020, with more than 10,000 police officers trained in it, and sets as a 2021 objective 100% usage/completion of the system by end of March 2021 and the migration of the CRO database and integration of Traffic and NTA databases on it by April 2021; no count of stations is given.
title: Force Annual Policing Plan 2021
